headline: Sri Lanka’s IRD surpasses 2026 revenue target after Customs
summary: Sri Lanka's government has raised its 2026 total tax revenue target to Rs.5,478 billion from Rs.4,910 billion. The IRD has surpassed its target after gains from Customs.
why: Tax revenue targets underpin fiscal planning and debt-servicing capacity in Sri Lanka, which is central to its IMF programme and sovereign credit assessments. Revisions signal the state of government finances.
